name: Gloves of Thievery

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: +5 to Sleight of Hand checks and to Dexterity checks to pick locks.
text: These gloves are invisible while worn. While wearing them, you gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks and Dexterity checks made to pick locks.
